item.title: Silicon Leak: Alice Huang's Network and the Nvidia Chip Breach
item.dc:creator: Amarjeet Singh
item.description:
A high-stakes chip scandal exposes severe vulnerabilities in US export controls, as banned Nvidia processors route straight to Chinese networks via Singapore intermediaries.
[SPLIT] ⚡ The scandal led to the abrupt resignation of Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang following revelations of improper personal ties to Alice Huang. [SPLIT] ⚡ Singapore-based intermediaries like Megaspeed International and Aperia Cloud Services are facing active international investigations. item.title: Sovereign Tech Fallout: Global Cloud Outage Exposes Critical Risks
item.dc:creator: Amarjeet Singh
item.description:
When a cloud outage paralyzes the UK NHS, European exchanges, and Indian enterprises, it reveals an uncomfortable truth: single-vendor software monopolies are a strategic threat to national security. Here is our deep-dive analysis.
[SPLIT] ⚡ Unplanned SaaS disruptions open dangerous shadow-IT attack vectors as personnel migrate sensitive communications to unmonitored personal accounts. [SPLIT] ⚡ India's digital transition requires multi-vendor diversification and open-source stacks rather than replacing one foreign platform monopoly with a domestic equivalent. [SPLIT] 🔗 Read full report → https://neodymium.world/articles/sovereign-tech-fallout-global-cloud-outage-exposes-critical-risks-571119.html
